metadata.description: Plugins from Just, the maker of Just Domain and Just Publish.

plugins.name: just
plugins.description: Find a name and a domain for your business, and put your website online. Just Domain checks which domain names are available, what each costs to register and renew, and links to register one on justdomain.ai; no account is needed to search. Just Publish puts a static site live at a public link, edits it later and helps connect your domain; you sign in once. Nothing is bought in the chat: you register and pay on justdomain.ai.
